supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:35 UTC, emma.stone created the alerted account tmp.rwong on DC-PIN-01.
The account name follows the documented tmp.<name> temporary-account convention, and emma.stone is documented as authorized to create domain accounts.
About two seconds after creation, emma.stone added tmp.rwong to Temp-Staff.
The account-creation event uses logon ID 0x2faf70f, matching emma.stone's domain logon from WS-ESTONE-01 at 13:39:08 UTC; that logon record shows source IP 10.51.10.24.

The observed creation and Temp-Staff assignment are consistent with the documented help-desk temporary-account process; the available evidence does not indicate that this alerted activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: These records show the creation and a Temp-Staff group addition, but do not provide a complete snapshot of the account's group memberships or privileges.
The evidence does not show who requested or approved the temporary account, or how it was used after creation.
The records associate the creation with emma.stone's logon session, but do not independently verify who was operating that session.
claims_not_established: That tmp.rwong was never added to any group other than Temp-Staff or granted elevated privileges.
That the account was used only for an authorized temporary-work purpose.
That the unusual remote-access activity by emma.stone in the review window was related to this account creation.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation recommended: emma.stone, a help-desk user rather than the designated IT administrator, launched SSH to PROXY-PIN-01 and initiated RDP sessions to DC-PIN-01 and FILE-PIN-01. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-RPATEL-01. These events do not establish that the account creation was malicious. Records: T088-00069 through T088-00085, T088-00091 through T088-00103.

Separate investigation recommended: domain authentication events for emma.stone show source IP 10.51.10.23, while the workstation logon and the account-creation session are associated with WS-ESTONE-01 at 10.51.10.24. The available records do not explain the .23 source. Records: T088-00048, T088-00051 through T088-00054.

Separate review recommended: Google Drive File Stream ran on WS-ESTONE-01 and Chrome accessed Google Docs; the inventory lists Microsoft 365/OneDrive as approved and no other cloud-storage services as approved. This is unrelated to the alerted account creation. Records: T088-00008 through T088-00010, T088-00027, T088-00043 through T088-00047, T088-00049 through T088-00050.
